claims.text: JANUS proposes disaggregating attention and MoE layers onto separate GPU worker pools with adaptive communication, activation scheduling, and SLO-aware scaling.
The collected arXiv record reports up to 4.7x per-GPU throughput over evaluated MoE inference baselines while satisfying token-level latency SLOs.

limitations.text: The collected artifact is arXiv v4 updated on 2026-08-11; chronology is anchored to the 2025-12-15 initial submission, while technical wording may include post-period revisions.
Reported performance is an author evaluation, not independently reproduced.
